script = '''
import fitz  # PyMuPDF
import os, sys

pdf_path = "uploads/handbook.pdf"
doc = fitz.open(pdf_path)

print(f"PDF: {pdf_path}")
print(f"Total pages: {len(doc)}")
print("=" * 70)

# --- Part 1: Extract embedded text from ALL pages ---
print("\\n===== EXTRACTED TEXT (all pages) =====\\n")
all_text = []
for i, page in enumerate(doc):
    text = page.get_text()
    all_text.append(text)
    print(f"--- Page {i+1} ---")
    print(text.strip() if text.strip() else "(no embedded text)")
    print()

# --- Part 2: OCR on the first page image ---
print("=" * 70)
print("\\n===== OCR ON FIRST PAGE IMAGE =====\\n")

page0 = doc[0]
# Render first page to image at 300 DPI
zoom = 300 / 72  # 72 is default DPI
mat = fitz.Matrix(zoom, zoom)
pix = page0.get_pixmap(matrix=mat)
img_path = "output/handbook_page1.png"
os.makedirs("output", exist_ok=True)
pix.save(img_path)
print(f"First page rendered to {img_path} ({pix.width}x{pix.height} px)")

# OCR with pytesseract
from PIL import Image
import pytesseract

img = Image.open(img_path)
ocr_text = pytesseract.image_to_string(img)
print("\\nOCR Result (Page 1):")
print("-" * 40)
print(ocr_text.strip() if ocr_text.strip() else "(no text detected by OCR)")
print("-" * 40)

doc.close()
print("\\nDone.")
'''
await write_file("./extract_pdf.py", script)
print("Script written.")

result = await run_command("python ./extract_pdf.py")
print(result)
